images.title: Before the sweeping bend
images.alt: The narrow gravel bend curls tightly around the rocky hill beneath Aster before the version 7.5 road revision.

images.title: Inspecting the original bend
images.alt: An inspection view follows the tight dirt bend and the exposed ground beneath the central house pillar.

images.title: Truck and soil inspection
images.alt: A blue flatbed truck stands on the bend while the inner soil bank and road support are inspected.

images.title: The outward sweep
images.alt: The revised gravel road makes a broad continuous sweep around the rock group toward the garage.

images.title: Meeting the existing road
images.alt: A close roadside view shows the gravel approach joining the existing hairpin beside the rocky slope.

images.title: Tracing the pale road scar
images.alt: A pale retired trail remains visible on the hillside during the version 7.5 terrain-texture inspection.

images.title: The repaired hillside scar
images.alt: The old trail trace blends into the rough ground above the new gravel bend beneath Aster.

images.title: Percheron on the bend
images.alt: A long blue Percheron flatbed truck follows the outer gravel bend around the rocky hillside.

images.title: Sweeping Bend overview
images.alt: Aster rises above its rocky hill with the wider gravel approach curving around the base.

images.title: The routes before version 8
images.alt: An elevated view shows Aster above its network of gravel approaches before the version 8 asphalt and reclamation work.

images.title: The marked shortcut before reclamation
images.alt: The old pale U-shaped alternate trail is still visible across the south-facing hillside below Aster.

images.title: The first asphalt pass
images.alt: The house is seen from above during the first asphalt pass, with multiple pale routes still visible on the surrounding hill.

images.title: The original route’s first asphalt pass
images.alt: The initial asphalt pass on the original uphill approach is shown with an in-game diagnostic overlay.

images.title: The sweeping bend’s first asphalt pass
images.alt: The initial dark asphalt hairpin curves around the hill below the garage and white central pillar.

images.title: The first glossy apron
images.alt: The first asphalt apron reflects a strong patch of sunlight in front of Aster’s wide garage arch.

images.title: The asphalt routes take shape
images.alt: An overhead view shows the first dark asphalt approaches beneath Aster’s white curved wings and glass crown.

images.title: The first reclamation pass
images.alt: The first reclamation pass leaves a pale old trail trace visible across the broad reshaped hillside.

images.title: Reclamation in progress
images.alt: A wide view follows the former shortcut across the hillside during the ground and texture-repair work.

images.title: Studying the reconstructed slope
images.alt: The reconstructed south-facing slope is inspected below Aster’s cantilevered white wings during the reclamation work.

images.title: The initial asphalt edge
images.alt: A reflective asphalt hairpin meets a pale rough shoulder before the later pavement-edge refinements.

images.title: An early shoulder inspection
images.alt: A curved asphalt road hugs the rock group while an in-game diagnostic overlay is visible during an early shoulder inspection.

images.title: Testing the native pavement surface
images.alt: A native pavement material test shows the curved gray road with a dark rim and pale natural ground beyond it.

images.title: A render test during construction
images.alt: The road bend is viewed under an in-game overlay during an intermediate render test with patchy surface artifacts.

images.title: An exact-surface experiment
images.alt: An intermediate asphalt-surface experiment shows conspicuous checker-like bright patches across the outside of the bend.

images.title: Contact boundary before reload
images.alt: A broad matte asphalt curve meets the natural shoulder during the contact-boundary pass before reload.

images.title: Earlier edge pass after reload
images.alt: The earlier reloaded edge pass shows the asphalt bend with a pronounced sunlight reflection across its right-hand surface.

images.title: The original approach during edge work
images.alt: The earlier asphalt version of the original approach curves uphill beside the exposed rock face.

images.title: The sweeping bend during edge work
images.alt: The earlier asphalt hairpin wraps around the rocky hill during its pavement-edge refinement.

images.title: Garage apron before the matte finish
images.alt: A bright reflection crosses the earlier asphalt apron below the circular balconies and arched garage entrance.

images.title: Overview during edge refinement
images.alt: An elevated view shows the asphalt approaches circling Aster’s hill during the earlier edge-refinement pass.

images.title: Previewing the pavement cap
images.alt: The raised asphalt bend is inspected with the in-game overlay visible while its pavement cap is previewed.

images.title: An early rolled-edge preview
images.alt: A low close-up shows a reflective road-edge preview with a conspicuous pale seam along the natural shoulder.

images.title: A quieter surface preview
images.alt: A preview view shows a subdued asphalt curve and its thin boundary beside the rocky inner slope.

images.title: Final matte pavement edge
images.alt: The final matte asphalt bend ends at a continuous dark rolled edge against natural rock and soil.

images.title: The final rolled edge
images.alt: A low close-up shows the matte asphalt shoulder rolling down to a narrow dark lip beside rough natural ground.

images.title: The sweeping bend in matte asphalt
images.alt: The final broad asphalt hairpin sweeps around the preserved rock group and climbs toward Aster’s garage.

images.title: The original approach, resurfaced
images.alt: The final matte asphalt follows the original approach up the hillside beneath Aster’s cantilevered wings.

images.title: The final garage apron
images.alt: A continuous matte asphalt apron reaches the wide catenary-shaped garage entrance in Aster’s cylindrical centre.

images.title: Asphalt and reclaimed slopes
images.alt: The final Aster house and both matte asphalt approaches sit above a rocky coastal hillside and the sea.

images.title: The shortcut returned to hillside
images.alt: The final wide view shows a continuous natural hillside beneath Aster after the U-shaped shortcut was retired.

images.title: Final reclaimed slope, close up
images.alt: A close view of the final rocky hillside shows irregular soil and vegetation where the retired shortcut once crossed.

images.title: Relocation inspection
images.alt: Aster — site studies: relocation inspection.
